description: Wait up to seconds (default 25, at most 55) for a run to finish, then return it: one call instead of polling get_run every few seconds. Call it again while final is false. The answer comes back the moment the run is final (verdict, checks and evidence in), or when the time is up with final false — then call wait_run again. Runs take 2 to 20 minutes, so expect several calls for a long run; each costs nothing while it waits. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/

seconds.description: How long to wait at most, 1–55 (default 25)

name: wait_run
title: Wait for a run
